## Variables

### tenantIdSchema

```ts
const tenantIdSchema: brand<String, "OysterTenantId">;
```

A host-minted tenant slug: 2–40 lowercase ASCII letters or digits, with single
interior hyphens. The repository separator `--` is forbidden. Hosts resolve it
before authentication; App-controlled inputs never select it.

---

### defaultTenant

```ts
const defaultTenant: TenantId;
```

The single-tenant Oyster identity whose durable names remain unchanged.

## Functions

### tenantScope()

```ts
function tenantScope(tenantId, origin): TenantScope;
```

Name tenant-owned stores without changing any default-tenant name. The `t.`
repository namespace cannot be a default installation slug, which forbids dots.
Hub supplies its own Team-scoped ports and does not use this naming contract.

| ---------- | ---------------------------------------- |

### singleTenant()

```ts
function singleTenant(origin): TenantResolver;
```

Admit defaultTenant only at the configured origin. Scheme, host and port must
match after URL canonicalization; unknown origins never fall back to default.

| --------- | -------- |
